name: ANA-06 - Confirmacao de exame na vespera (09:00)

nodes.name: Buscar exames do proximo dia util

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: $json.guard.payload.phone, text: $json.guard.payload.texto, delay: 0, linkPreview: false }) }}

parameters.query: WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb j), ins AS (INSERT INTO ana_envios_log(phone,tipo) SELECT j->>'phone','lembrete_vespera' FROM p RETURNING phone),u AS (UPDATE ana_leads l SET agendamento=COALESCE(l.agendamento,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('confirmacao_enviada_em',now()),proxima_acao=CASE WHEN l.bot_ativo=true THEN 'aguardar_confirmacao_vespera' ELSE l.proxima_acao END,updated_at=now() FROM p,ins WHERE l.phone=ins.phone AND l.agendamento->>'data'=p.j->>'data' AND l.agendamento->>'hora'=p.j->>'hora' RETURNING l.phone) SELECT count(*)::int AS applied FROM u;

main.node: Buscar exames do proximo dia util
